rules.statement: A superior court has the inherent power to make restitution when its own act causes injury to a suitor, and this power can be exercised by directing that an erroneous order be undone.
rules.supporting_quote: "Therefore when the injunction issued by the Court of Appeal on the 26th of May, 1989, was dissolved on 5th September, 1989, it was competent for the court to direct that the appellant who had obtained possession of the property on the strength of the injunction by displacing the respondent, be in turn displaced and possession handed back to the respondent"
